segments.name: Oncology/Immunology
segments.description: Discovers, develops and commercializes targeted therapies and immunotherapies for patients with cancer and immunological diseases, and out-licenses in-house developed drugs to partners.
segments.evidence: The Group's operating segments are Oncology/Immunology and Other Ventures.

segments.name: Other Ventures
segments.description: Manufactures, markets and distributes prescription drugs and healthcare products in China through drug marketing and distribution platforms.
segments.evidence: We have built large-scale and profitable drug marketing and distribution capabilities through our Other Ventures operations, which primarily manufacture, market and distribute prescription drugs in China.

revenueModel.text: Collaboration partners pay upfront payments, research and development cost reimbursements, milestone payments and sales-based royalties, while hospitals and distributors pay for drug products.
revenueModel.evidence: The transaction price generally includes fixed and variable consideration in the form of upfront payment, research and development cost reimbursements, contingent milestone payments and sales-based royalties.

changes.text: In 2025 the company completed the divestment of its interest in Shanghai Hutchison Pharmaceuticals, retaining a small minority stake.
changes.evidence: In April 2025, we completed the divestment of an aggregate of 45% equity interest and retained 5% equity interest in Shanghai Hutchison Pharmaceuticals.

changes.text: In 2023 the company disposed of its consolidated joint venture Hutchison Hain Organic and its wholly owned subsidiary HUTCHMED Science Nutrition.
changes.evidence: In December 2023, we disposed of our interests in our consolidated joint venture Hutchison Hain Organic and our wholly owned subsidiary HUTCHMED Science Nutrition.
